module: Flowgraph module (moduleOrder 0) that manages timers. It keeps three cumulative global clocks (real, sim, raw) updated by onUpdate with dtReal, dtSim and dtRaw; each timer references one of them (mode 'dtSim', 'dtReal' or 'dtRaw'), has a start time, a duration (default 5 s) and can be paused. The values are stored in a variableStorage and finalized at the end of the tick.
notes: Units: seconds. Default mode: 'dtSim' (simulation time, affected by slow motion and pause).
Pauses are deferred: setPause sets a flag (pauseFlag) applied in afterTrigger.
Probable bug: clear() does C.idCounter = 0 on the class and not on self; the instance keeps its id counter if self.idCounter was already created.
setMode uses variables:set whereas the other functions use variables:change; the exact behavior depends on variableStorage (not checked here).
setPause raises an error if the id is unknown.

getFreeId.desc: Increments and returns a timer id.

init.desc: Creates the variableStorage and calls clear().

clear.desc: Clears variables and timers, resets the global clocks to 0.

getGlobalTime.desc: Returns the global clock of the requested mode.

returns.desc: cumulative time (s), 0 if the mode is unknown

addTimer.desc: Creates a timer and returns its id.

data.desc: mode (default 'dtSim'), time (time already elapsed, default 0), duration (default 5)

getTimer.desc: Returns the full timer object (start, mode, duration, isPaused...).

set.desc: Changes a timer field (start, mode, duration) via the variableStorage.

setPause.desc: Pauses or resumes a timer; the effect is applied in afterTrigger. Does nothing if the requested state is already the current one; warns if a flag is already set.

setElapsedTime.desc: Sets a timer's elapsed time (paused: stores the value; otherwise recomputes the start).

setMode.desc: Changes the timer's clock mode while keeping the elapsed time (if not paused).

getElapsedTime.desc: Returns the elapsed time: frozen value if paused, otherwise the mode's clock minus the start.

isComplete.desc: True if the elapsed time has reached the duration.

onUpdate.desc: Called on every manager update: adds dtReal, dtSim and dtRaw to the global clocks.

afterTrigger.desc: Called after the graph tick: applies the pending pauses or resumes then finalizes the variables.

executionStopped.desc: Called when the project stops: calls clear().
